dict.string: Every-30-min GitHub-issues read-only triage for stuinfla/ruvnet-brain. Runs scripts/issue-fix.mjs in explicit unattended mode: it inventories eligible open issues and marks them as needing session supervision. It creates no worktree, changes no code, pushes no branch, posts no public comment, and performs no promotion. Wrapped in job-heartbeat.sh per the house positive-confirmation pattern (see config/scheduled-jobs.json, scripts/nightly-watchdog.mjs) — a crash still leaves a receipt and pages the phone; silence is not health. Runs alongside, and does not replace, com.ruvnet.issue-watch (detection/SLA-alert only).
